name: PLAG1 zinc finger
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: PLAG1 encodes zinc finger protein PLAG1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to silver-russell syndrome 4 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Malignant mixed tumor of skin; Carcinoma ex pleomorphic adenoma; Carcinosarcoma of salivary gland. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
